title: Top Commodity Brokers Prepare for First AI Compute Futures Trade

tickers.name: BGC Group, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
ADM Investor Services, BGC Group, and Nanhua America are organizing the systems needed to execute derivatives trades for hedge funds, commodity traders, and institutional investors. The brokerage firms are targeting instruments tied to the cost of renting artificial intelligence processing power in anticipation of a ruling from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission on compute futures.

This shift follows formal petitions to the CFTC by the Crypto Council and HyperliquidPC to authorize perpetual and dated futures in U.S. markets. The proponents argue that because AI compute is a constant economic resource, developers and data center lenders face pricing risks that run around the clock without a fixed expiration date.

Today, HPC filed a comment letter asking the @CFTC to bring compute perpetual contracts to U.S. markets.

Data centers, their lenders, and the AI developers that rent compute all carry price risk, and the exposure runs around the clock with no fixed end date. Our comment explains why compute meets the test for a successful futures market and why perpetual contracts fit an exposure that never expires.
